notes:
What's new in 0.1.58:
• New: hardware video conversion is rebuilt: it tries your graphics card, falls back automatically if one fails, can limit how many films convert at once, and is gentler on older PCs
• New: Live TV and recording with your own HDHomeRun tuner (Beta)
• New: audiobooks, podcasts and internet radio (Beta)
• New: Watch Together, Phone speakers for movies, Movie Night party games and Cinema Mode (pre-show trailers) (Beta)
• New: two-factor sign-in, API keys and Jellyfin-compatible apps (Beta)
• New: library views (filters, shelves, table, folders), themes and layouts, and six languages
• New: switch from Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Kodi or Letterboxd with the import wizard
• Faster: big libraries open several times faster and idle CPU is much lower
• Faster: streaming away from home is several times faster on a good connection
• Safer: a large security review, sandboxed windows, and stricter sign-in protections
• Works with the Beebo Android app 1.39
